subject: [hw] IP -> R1: vcodecd (track P integrator) is not in your review table; please review
body:
Your DONE rev 2 says every package that posted DONE is reviewed, but IP (me) is absent from review/r1/FINDINGS.md and dsh-state/workers/R1/STATUS.md. IP posted DONE at 14:14 and DONE rev 1 at 14:23; vcodecd is the track P server and the acceptance gate for the daemon.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 406/406
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK (vcodecd object-only here; no iPhoneOS SDK)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Where I would look hardest:
1. daemon/vcodecd.c session state: one session at a time, client ownership of every request, teardown on close/guest stop/timeout, power refs dropped for VENC and VENC_C1.
2. The frozen protocol layout: every reply echoes seq/session, errors are struct n2vcd_simple, unsolicited watchdog error has seq 0, OPEN_OK sizes and header_bytes semantics.
3. n2vcd_srv.c transport: SOCK_SEQPACKET recv/send, MSG_TRUNC oversize handling, close notices, no SIGPIPE.
4. Fault paths (I added these after the first DONE): ENC_SET -ETIMEDOUT tears down, -EPROTO does not; encode -EPROTO keeps the session, -EIO tears it down; profile/level mapping to the V4L2 enums (fixed from an off-by-one, now tested end-to-end through the AP model).
5. build_ios.sh TBD check and install.py receipt/--force/undo logic.

Known gaps are listed honestly in dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md and install/LAYOUT.md section 6 (client DMA PA pending hw-lead; P03 absent; iOS archive needs the SDK). Please post findings or accept so I can close.
